title: Reactome cancer-pathway membership track pack (hg38)
context: Reactome is a CC-BY 4.0-licensed, expert-curated pathway database. It is covered in the M2 pack task (pack-016); this source-catalog entry records the per-source gate triage for the Reactome source broadly. The CC-BY attribution requirement means every derived track file and browser config must carry the Reactome attribution string, making it important to wire attribution into the manifest fields from the first gate artifact.
objective: Apply the licensegate-002 gate to Reactome (capturing CC-BY 4.0 attribution requirements), produce a committed PASS artifact, and deliver the Reactome cancer-pathway track pack on hg38 if not already covered by pack-016.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is Reactome (CC-BY 4.0); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true and the required attribution string captured.
CC-BY attribution string is embedded in the manifest and in the track description of every emitted browser config.
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38; coordinate convention handled and recorded.
All three browser targets emitted and render-verified; Reactome pathway-gene features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/ds-reactome-006.json.
Per-feature provenance records Reactome pathway IDs, source release version, and CC-BY 4.0 license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
output: output/packs/reactome-pathways-hg38/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-reactome-006.json.
